label:
Milk protein
concentrate
note: Casein and whey proteins stay in the same ratio as in milk, unlike a caseinate or a whey protein.

about.text: Skimmed milk run through an ultrafiltration membrane, often with water added to wash more lactose out, and then dried: a powder of 40 to 90 % milk protein that has the casein and whey proteins in the ratio of milk. Used in protein drinks, yoghurts, bars and to raise the protein in cheese milk.

how.text: Skim milk is concentrated on an ultrafiltration membrane that keeps the casein and whey proteins and lets lactose, minerals and water through; for the higher grades water is added and filtered out again (diafiltration), then the retentate is evaporated and spray-dried.

steps.note: Pasteurised skim milk on a membrane that keeps the casein and whey proteins and lets lactose, minerals and water through.
Water is added and filtered out again to wash out lactose, needed above about 70 % protein.
The retentate is evaporated to 12–18 % solids before drying (MPC85/MCC85).
